sub: A single forecast can go your way by chance. But Jameye scores every prediction on calibration — so over many resolutions, luck cancels out and skill compounds. The leaderboard ends up ranking the sharpest minds, not the luckiest.

cards.title: Score on calibration
cards.body: Every prediction is graded by a proper scoring rule (Brier score). The only way to climb is to report what you truly believe, as accurately as you can. Bluffing and hedging both cost you.

cards.title: Luck cancels out
cards.body: On one event, a 70% call can still lose. Across hundreds, the good breaks and bad breaks average away — leaving only your real edge.

cards.title: Skill compounds
cards.body: The more you forecast, the harder it gets for a lucky guesser to outrank a calibrated mind. Volume is the filter — and tournaments are built on volume.

sim.title: Watch luck wash out.
sim.sub: Drag to resolve more predictions. With only a few, lucky guesses crowd the field. Add resolutions and luck drains away — calibrated forecasters separate out and cluster at the top scores.

verdicts.few: Too few to tell — the guesser looks just as sharp as the skilled forecaster.
verdicts.some: Separation starting — skill is beginning to show through the noise.
verdicts.many: A clear gap opens — calibration pulls ahead of pure luck.
verdicts.settled: Settled — skill owns the top scores, luck sits in the middle.
